tiers.title: 1 · Price ranges
tiers.description: A line's unit price after discount (per meter / unit) picks its range; the line earns that range's rate.
tiers.overlap: Some ranges overlap: a price in two ranges uses the first one.
tiers.hint: Leave a range's rate at 0 to switch it off. Products listed below use their category rate instead of the matching range rate.

products.title: 2 · Product categories
products.description: Set a commission rate for each category, then pick products (optionally one colour) to classify as slow-moving or digital.
products.empty: No products yet — use the + buttons to add them.
products.hint: Classified products use their category rate instead of the price-range rate. A colour-specific classification wins over the same product for all colours. Enter each rep's slow-moving target in the table below.
products.colors: {count, plural, =0 {no colours} one {# colour} other {# colours}}

rules.title: 3 · Conditions, bonuses and deductions
rules.description: Applied on top of the line commission once total achievement reaches the full system.
rules.allTargetsHint: Of the line commission (total + every category target)
rules.oldModeBase: Line commission, no bonuses or deductions
rules.minimumHint: A note is flagged under this amount at month end
rules.ladderHint: The highest step whose range holds the rep's monthly sales is paid (only one).
rules.detailsHint: Ticked categories can be opened in the seller's Statement to list the products sold, their prices and quantities (meters).
rules.minAchievementHint: Empty = paid only once the target is met (100%).
